author: KroestV2
body:
Dear Avicus staff,

I got banned July 24, for advertising the Overcast Network (account avicus.net/kroest). I tried to appeal that like 3 months later i think?(avicus.net/Pistolento i think) i did not get unbanned because i ban evaded on a different account. 

I understand that you permanently ban people that advertise other networks and/or ban evade. I am sorry for committing these two crimes. I would highly appreciate it if you could give me another chance on this network, i see a bright future ahead of us. 

Best, 

Kroest

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hey Kroest,

First I would like to say I am incredibly sorry for the delayed response I wish I was aware you appealed sooner than now, but thank you for bumping this appeal. Since you have been banned for quite a while I have decided to give you another chance and appeal your ban.
Please update yourself with the rules as they may have changed a bit since your last time on avicus.
Welcome back! 

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator
